changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Preserve metadata audit history without copying rows for geometry-only version increments.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION gps_track_update_trigger() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN -- Geometry revisions change the cache version, not the audited metadata. IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'version') = (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'version') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF; IF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' OR TG_OP = 'DELETE') THEN INSERT INTO gps_track_audit ( version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, creator, gpx_version, meta_name, meta_description, meta_time, meta_author, track_name, track_description, start_date, end_date, median_distance_between_points, avg_distance_between_points, max_distance_between_points, did_filter_outlier_by_distance, number_of_track_points, track_length_in_meter, track_type, utm_zone, create_date, load_status, load_messages, duplicate_status, duplicate_of, activity_type, activity_type_source, activity_type_source_details, garmin_activity_id, meta_link, duplicate_details, update_date, source_segment_index, source_parent_track_id ) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, OLD.id, OLD.file_id, OLD.creator, OLD.gpx_version, OLD.meta_name, OLD.meta_description, OLD.meta_time, OLD.meta_author, OLD.track_name, OLD.track_description, OLD.start_date, OLD.end_date, OLD.median_distance_between_points, OLD.avg_distance_between_points, OLD.max_distance_between_points, OLD.did_filter_outlier_by_distance, OLD.number_of_track_points, OLD.track_length_in_meter, OLD.track_type, OLD.utm_zone, OLD.create_date, OLD.load_status, OLD.load_messages, OLD.duplicate_status, OLD.duplicate_of, OLD.activity_type, OLD.activity_type_source, OLD.activity_type_source_details, OLD.garmin_activity_id, OLD.meta_link, OLD.duplicate_details, OLD.update_date, OLD.source_segment_index, OLD.source_parent_track_id FROM gps_track_audit WHERE id = OLD.id;
ELSIF (TG_OP = 'INSERT') THEN INSERT INTO gps_track_audit ( version, operation, changed_at, id, file_id, creator, gpx_version, meta_name, meta_description, meta_time, meta_author, track_name, track_description, start_date, end_date, median_distance_between_points, avg_distance_between_points, max_distance_between_points, did_filter_outlier_by_distance, number_of_track_points, track_length_in_meter, track_type, utm_zone, create_date, load_status, load_messages, duplicate_status, duplicate_of, activity_type, activity_type_source, activity_type_source_details, garmin_activity_id, meta_link, duplicate_details, update_date, source_segment_index, source_parent_track_id ) SELECT 1, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NEW.id, NEW.file_id, NEW.creator, NEW.gpx_version, NEW.meta_name, NEW.meta_description, NEW.meta_time, NEW.meta_author, NEW.track_name, NEW.track_description, NEW.start_date, NEW.end_date, NEW.median_distance_between_points, NEW.avg_distance_between_points, NEW.max_distance_between_points, NEW.did_filter_outlier_by_distance, NEW.number_of_track_points, NEW.track_length_in_meter, NEW.track_type, NEW.utm_zone, NEW.create_date, NEW.load_status, NEW.load_messages, NEW.duplicate_status, NEW.duplicate_of, NEW.activity_type, NEW.activity_type_source, NEW.activity_type_source_details, NEW.garmin_activity_id, NEW.meta_link, NEW.duplicate_details, NEW.update_date, NEW.source_segment_index, NEW.source_parent_track_id; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
